'''G21''' was the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] that was sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] to secure [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] for [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|invasion]].
